question.text: Allocation Effect in performance attribution = Σ [(Wa - Wp) × Rp_sector]. This isolates:

answer.text: The gain/loss from deviating from benchmark sector weights

explanation.text: The Logic: Allocation = (Portfolio weight - Benchmark weight) × Benchmark sector return. Shows how much the PM's sector tilts contributed to active return. The Trap: Selection effect uses (Ra - Rp) × Wp; attribution and selection are separate. Cross-Exam Context: XV, XXI-B. Manager's Pro-Tip: High allocation alpha = top-down manager; high selection alpha = bottom-up picker — use attribution to label the manager's style.
